facts: Status: DEPLOYED in environment Enterprise Hub
Protocol: MCP (Tool contracts exposed through a model-context boundary.)
Security: Sandbox (Tool execution separated from the agent reasoning core.)
Governance: Schemas (Inputs and outputs validated before model use.)
Adoption: Playbooks (Reusable patterns for enterprise engineering teams.)
Component Admin UI: Enterprise developer hub (Surfaces approved tools, access docs, and examples for engineering teams.)
Component MCP host: JSON-RPC protocol client (Loads tool schemas, brokers calls, and keeps protocol details outside the agent prompt.)
Component Database tool: PostgreSQL server wrapper (Encapsulates database access behind typed operations instead of direct model access.)
Component External APIs: Third-party sandbox client (Limits outbound API calls to approved capabilities with explicit request schemas.)
Component Agent core: Schema-validated tool reasoning (Receives controlled tool outputs and composes responses without owning raw credentials.)
